title: Progress contract: per-file percent, aggregate percent, and a polite live-region tick
description: Every file in the upload set carries a per-file percent that advances monotonically from 0 to 100. The surface also carries an aggregate percent that reflects the mean weighted by byte size. A polite live-region wrapper (aria-live polite) receives a text tick at least every 10 percent of aggregate progress with the string format "<uploaded> of <total> files, <PP> percent". The polite wrapper is preseeded at render time so a screen reader adopts it before the first tick fires.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.2, REQ 2.
